one_liner: Senior budget and administrative officer in ODNI's CFO office, building and defending intelligence budgets to OMB and Congress while running office HR, contracts, and operations.
fit_summary: This GS-14 role requires extensive, GS-14-equivalent experience in IC, DoD, or military budget formulation, programming, and execution (IPOM, IPBS, CBJ), plus a TS/SCI clearance. Daniel's policy knowledge, relationship skills, and IEM consulting background give some overlap with Congressional engagement and coordination, but nothing on file shows senior resource-management experience. Apply only if Daniel's IEM work involved substantial federal budget or financial management.
eligibility: Open to the public; current federal employees GS-13 and above only (Daniel, with no federal service, applies as a member of the public).
Mandatory: extensive knowledge of IC, DoD, OMB, and Congressional budget processes, and Resource or Financial Management experience equivalent to GS-14.
Must obtain and maintain a Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance; this is an excepted-service position.
strategy: Before investing time, honestly assess whether your IEM work included budget formulation, cost estimating, grant or contract funding tracking, or federal financial management at a senior level; if not, target GS-9 to GS-12 budget or program analyst roles instead.

If you did work on budgets at IEM, frame it in federal terms: describe client appropriations, obligations, funding tracking, data calls, and justification documents. Give dates and hours per week, and fit everything within the two-page USAJOBS limit.
Highlight your Congressional and policy knowledge alongside your relationship-building skills, since the duties include Congressional testimony input, QFRs, and cross-agency coordination.
Write the four 200-word essays yourself. The posting requires certification that you did not use AI or a consultant, so use concrete examples with real outcomes.
Apply between Oct 19 and Nov 3, 2026, and gather your degree transcript and any documents listed under Required Documents early.
resume_bullets: Supported [federal/state client] emergency management programs by tracking [budget/obligations/expenditures] of [$amount] and preparing [reports/justifications] for [audience], [hours]/week, [dates].
Coordinated responses to [number] client data calls and leadership taskings across [agencies/stakeholders], delivering [products] on [timeline].
Built working relationships with [government officials/partners] to reach consensus on [program/funding priority], resulting in [outcome].
interview_questions: Walk us through the phases of an intelligence or defense program build, from the POM through the CBJ.
Describe a time you had to justify a resource request to skeptical senior leaders or external overseers.
How would you prepare a response to a Congressional Question for the Record on a budget execution issue?
Tell us about managing competing priorities while supporting hiring or personnel actions for an office.
watch_outs: Mandatory IC/DoD budget experience at the GS-14 level makes this very unlikely without a direct budget background.
A TS/SCI clearance is required; the investigation is lengthy, and the role is on-site in McLean with no telework.
The application window is only about two weeks (Oct 19 to Nov 3, 2026).
